Static decoding executes no Lua, VM bytecode, native API, PowerShell command or downloaded stage.
Recovered RPC eth_call/contract constants are configuration evidence; no live C2 lookup was made.

The DNS rule accepts the dig-only/uppercase-hex variant; SSH rules do not require .user/.pass field names.
